== Summary ==
[[Greg Heisler]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]], after the Young Jedi World Championship final. Cropped from [[:File:Greg Heisler and Matthew Reed DecipherCon 1999 sat54.jpg]] (crop box 25,20 to 212,300 of the 400×300 original). Photo: Decipher.

== Source ==
* [http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat54.html DecipherCon 1999 Saturday photo sat54], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Greg Heisler and Matt Reed after their Young Jedi World Championship final confrontation." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000602105923/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat54.html Internet Archive]
* Image: [http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/large/sat54.jpg sat54.jpg]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020311031903/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/large/sat54.jpg Internet Archive] (same bytes as the uncropped wiki file, SHA-256 f07a7b8b…).
* Identification: Decipher's caption names both men. The man on the left (cap, checked shirt, name badge) is the man in Decipher's "Go Greg Heisler!" world champion photo ([[:File:Greg Heisler DecipherCon 1999 world champion photo.gif]]) and the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' #48 card ([[:File:Greg Heisler 1999 Young Jedi Worlds player card.jpg]]). The man on the right matches [[Matthew Reed]]'s Insider card.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-4/43/Greg_Heisler_DecipherCon_1999.jpg Internet Archive item].
